acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce retry exhaustion after terminal cancelled attempts using real native CLI/store journal and demonstrate explicit recovery enables a fresh attempt without changing historical attempts.
Recovery requires authorized declared role, a nonempty bounded reason, expected ticket revision and current acceptance/attempt binding; reject active or stale attempts and unsafe ticket states.
Recovery never records a gate PASS or completion, never removes failed gates or approvals/dependency requirements, and preserves attempt history plus actor/reason in immutable audited receipts.
Prove request idempotency and replay/validation across fresh admission, failed-gate history, concurrency/revision conflict and invalid payloads; retain known qualification/authority unknowns.

Update owning CAL contract and public CLI documentation with stable requirement IDs, retain focused verification and independent review, publish and merge verified fix, integrate and complete native ticket with receipt audit.
body: GitHub #378: OPEN FL-001.matrix could not be claimed for independent verification after CANCELLED attempts reached retryCount3 with no recorded gate result. Add explicit owner/operator-authorized retry readmission with reason and expected revision. Preserve all attempt/gate history, acceptance binding, dependencies and approvals; no direct journal edits or implicit cancellation refund. Implement in isolated origin/main branch with focused CLI/store/transaction regression, independent plan/change review, spec/evidence and native completion. Scope remains INCOMPLETE until bounded implementation plan identifies exact effects.
title: Tasks: audited recovery for OPEN retry-exhausted tickets (issue #378)
